messages.subject: Project Larkspur - Replies to CPSE.1
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Please find attached our client's replies to CPSE.1. You'll note the outstanding open-market rent review on the Aldermere lease (review date 25 March 2026), which our client will assign to your client on completion, and a routine arrears reminder issued to Caldermoor Recruitment.

Do raise any follow-up enquiries.

Kind regards
Amelia Hart
Associate
Castle & Vane LLP
